gen.title: How each branch checks the others

steps.label: President vetoes congressional legislation
steps.quote: The president can veto legislation created by Congress.

steps.label: President nominates agency and court officials
steps.quote: He or she also nominates heads of federal agencies and high court appointees.

steps.label: Congress reviews presidential nominees
steps.quote: Congress confirms or rejects the president's nominees.

steps.label: Congress removes president in exceptional cases
steps.quote: It can also remove the president from office in exceptional circumstances.

steps.label: Justices overturn unconstitutional laws
steps.quote: The Justices of the Supreme Court can overturn unconstitutional laws.

steps.label: Justices are nominated and confirmed
steps.quote: These justices are nominated by the president and confirmed by the Senate.

every step has a distinct label after normalisation (distinct-steps)
steps count 6 is within 4-8; repair is by retry only (count-valid)
every number in labels, order hints and notes appears on the cited page or in the same quote (N-01) (numbers-checkable)
